description: Get AI generated videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompts (MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF, up to 500MB), say something like "generate a 10-second video clip of a futuristic city skyline at night", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for content creators who move fast and want to create videos without cameras or editing software.
